# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by crates/core/tests/reference_docs.rs; do not edit. -->

Keys and classes come from `settings::SETTING_CLASSES`; descriptions come from
its checked documentation supplement (`crates/core/tests/fixtures/reference_settings.json`).
Defaults shown as JSON are parsed values from typed loaders given an empty map,
never the process environment, a database or a deployment. Flags commonly use
`1` to enable; JSON booleans describe the resulting state, not the env syntax.
“Not specified in Next” means no default is supplied by this reference's typed
loaders or the classification-only catalog; it does not imply a legacy default,
a required value or an implemented consumer. Secret defaults are never rendered.

- `env_only`: never dashboard-stored. Unknown names and `TWO_INTERNAL_*` fail closed.
- `cold` / `hot`: legacy-catalog storage classes, not application promises.
The Container registers a `guild_settings` poll job
(`crates/bot/src/website_jobs.rs:207`) that polls every 15 s and publishes a
`SettingsCache` snapshot only when the revision or row count changes
(`crates/bot/src/settings_jobs.rs:146-160`), exposed through `settings_jobs::live`
(`crates/bot/src/settings_jobs.rs:53`). Every consumer reads store-first:
a stored row wins and an absent row falls back to the boot value, except
the invite responder, which falls back to the live vanity code; a live /ops override wins over the stored row while the container polls an ops record, falling back to the row on clear or expiry; a malformed
row falls back to a safe value, refuses, or filters entries depending on
the runtime (see below), and `None` while parked or pre-first-poll layers
nothing. Gateway
feature gates still come from process environment only, so a
database-only value such as `TWO_AUTOMATIONS=1` stays disabled
(re-checked at `1643438`).
Keys in
legacy `HOT_WIRED` are labeled “reload-report hot” (the `RefreshReport::hot`
partition in `settings.rs`); every other storable key reports cold.

`community_classifier.rs::classifier_config_from_live`):

The forty-nine keys in `STORE_READ_KEYS`
(`crates/core/tests/reference_docs.rs`) say “applied live by runtime refresh”
instead of “stored unwired”: containment applies `TWO_ANTI_NUKE_WINDOW_SECONDS`,
`TWO_ANTI_NUKE_EVENT_MAX_AGE_SECONDS`, `TWO_ANTI_NUKE_HEAT_THRESHOLD` and
`DISCORD_STAFF_ALERT_CHANNEL_ID`
(`crates/bot/src/containment_runtime.rs:61-67`, `:278-286`); join-risk applies
`TWO_JOIN_RISK_THRESHOLD`, `TWO_JOIN_RISK_WINDOW_SECONDS`,
`TWO_BULK_JOIN_WINDOW_UNTIL` and `DISCORD_STAFF_ALERT_CHANNEL_ID`
(`crates/bot/src/join_risk_runtime.rs:66-70`, `:239-249`); raid applies
`TWO_RAID_JOIN_THRESHOLD`, `TWO_RAID_WINDOW_SECONDS` and
`DISCORD_STAFF_ALERT_CHANNEL_ID`
(`crates/bot/src/raid_runtime.rs:45-48`, `:194-202`); all three refuse
malformed tuning instead of falling back, disabling observations/scoring
while refused (`crates/bot/src/containment_runtime.rs:318-330`,
`crates/bot/src/raid_runtime.rs:236-247`,
`crates/bot/src/join_risk_runtime.rs:300-309`); onboarding merges its
`CONFIG_KEYS` from a per-event snapshot
(`crates/bot/src/onboarding.rs:21-30`, `:271-295`), where only a malformed
dry-run row keeps the boot value (`:159-168`) while a malformed channel row
fails the job; message-path automod
applies its ten live lists, thresholds and the enforce flag from the snapshot
on every delivery (`crates/bot/src/automod_gateway.rs:116-127`, `:211-223`, `:328`);
the feed poller applies `TWO_FEED_POLL_SECONDS` from the snapshot to the
supervisor cadence and its per-tick schedule gate, so a changed interval
reschedules the next run to last-run + new interval without a restart
(`crates/bot/src/feed_jobs.rs:235-237`, `:276-327`); the audit mirror applies
`DISCORD_AUDIT_LOG_CHANNEL_ID`, `DISCORD_VOICE_LOG_CHANNEL_ID` and
`DISCORD_MODERATION_LOG_CHANNEL_ID` from the snapshot on every record and
sweep (`crates/bot/src/audit_runtime.rs:60-63`, `:308`, `:438`), where blanking
all three parks the mirror live and a malformed row keeps the last good
destinations; with no destination at boot, registration installs neither the
mirror handle nor the retry job, so a later stored destination cannot activate
that parked runtime (`crates/bot/src/audit_runtime.rs:137-161`); ticket
operations apply
`DISCORD_TICKET_CATEGORY_ID`, `DISCORD_TICKET_PANEL_CHANNEL_ID` and
`DISCORD_TICKET_STAFF_ROLE_ID` from the snapshot on every execute, recovery
and purge (`crates/bot/src/ticket_runtime.rs:778`, `:896`, `:1317`, `:1491`), where a
malformed row keeps the last good destinations like the audit mirror, and the same
refresh resolves `TWO_TICKET_COOLDOWN_SECONDS` from the effective layered values,
including ops apply, clearing and expiry without a database revision change, with
last-good fallback (`crates/bot/src/ticket_runtime.rs:719-744`); the feed poller
re-checks `TWO_ANNOUNCEMENTS` from the snapshot on every tick and skips while
a stored `0` stands (`crates/bot/src/feed_jobs.rs:250-267`, `:385-419`); self-role
dispatch and recovery resolve `TWO_SELF_ROLE_PANELS` from the snapshot on every
interaction and sweep, falling back to the boot catalogue on absent or unparsable
rows (`crates/bot/src/self_role_handlers.rs:59-83`, `:224`, `:309`, `:377`, `:419`).
Catalogue edits and deletes refuse while processing, terminal repair or unknown
exchanges remain; admission rechecks the same snapshot revision under the settings
writer lock. Drain first, then retry through the settings API. Do not bypass the
boundary with SQL or change boot catalogues before draining. The independently
expiring ops overlay cannot set `TWO_SELF_ROLE_PANELS`;
the gateway funnel applies
`TWO_COMMUNITY_HUMAN_CHANNEL_IDS`, `TWO_COMMUNITY_WELCOME_CHANNEL_IDS` and
the five actor/staging exclusion sets (`TWO_COMMUNITY_AUTOMATION_ACTOR_IDS`,
`TWO_COMMUNITY_RAID_ACTOR_IDS`, `TWO_COMMUNITY_STAGING_ACTOR_IDS`,
`TWO_COMMUNITY_STAGING_GUILD_IDS`, `TWO_COMMUNITY_TEST_ACTOR_IDS`) from the
snapshot before collecting or draining facts for guild `MessageCreate`,
`VoiceStateUpdate`, `MemberAdd`, `MemberUpdate` and `MemberRemove` dispatches
(`crates/bot/src/gateway.rs::refresh_channel_classifier_from_poller`,
`gateway.rs::apply_dispatch`). The classifier and community-facts sink refresh
together; message channel stamping uses that refreshed configuration. The
shared seven-key overlay is
`crates/bot/src/community_classifier.rs::classifier_config_from_live`.
Attendance uses the same overlay through the stateless `LiveClassifier`
provider installed with `InteractionRuntime::with_classifier_provider` by both
`main.rs::build_interaction_runtime` and `command_runtime.rs::CommandRuntime::build`.
Both `handle` and `prepare`/`complete` resolve `settings_jobs::live` inside
`rsvp.rs::execute` after successful acknowledgement and live membership reads,
immediately before target classification, not at runtime construction. Static
callers continue using `ClassifierConfig`. Each refresh/execution uses one
guild-scoped snapshot: stored sets replace boot sets, explicit empty clears a
set, and deleting a row restores boot fallback. Malformed entries are filtered
silently, so a wholly-malformed row applies as the empty set
(`crates/core/src/community.rs:252-260`). `TWO_COMMUNITY_CLASSIFIER_VERSION`
remains boot-only. The voice sweep applies `TWO_TEMP_VOICE_EMPTY_GRACE_SECONDS` from the snapshot on spawn and every maintenance refresh, so a stored per-guild grace reaches the deletion sweep without a restart (`crates/bot/src/voice_rooms.rs:8222-8230`, `:3571-3573`), and the invite responder applies `TWO_GUILD_INVITE_CODE` per `/invite` interaction (`crates/bot/src/voice_rooms.rs:14195-14204`), falling back to the live vanity code when the row is absent or invalid (`:10239-10255`); the community jobs apply `TWO_COMMUNITY_SCORECARD`, `TWO_COMMUNITY_RECOMMENDATIONS`, `TWO_COMMUNITY_CORRECTION_CYCLES`, `TWO_PRESENCE_PROBE` and `TWO_INACTIVITY_DAYS` from the snapshot on every tick, layering stored rows over the boot gates with boot fallback for absent or unparsable counts (`crates/bot/src/community_jobs.rs:170-268`), where a stored `0` on either enable gate skips that tick while the sweep re-reads its horizon per run. Five boot-only edges
remain: the voice room-name policy is
built once at boot from the process environment
(`crates/bot/src/gateway.rs:2339`); gateway intents plus ticket command
publication read the ticket destination keys once at boot
(`crates/bot/src/gateway.rs:150`, `crates/bot/src/command_runtime.rs:448`), so a stored ticket
destination reaches already-published commands only through the per-operation
refresh above; the community-facts sink arms once at boot
(`crates/bot/src/main.rs:697-698`), so a live scorecard `0` stops scoring but
not capture; the scorecard command surface publishes at boot
(`crates/bot/src/main.rs:1004`, `crates/bot/src/command_runtime.rs:440`); and
a boot-parked community job needs a restart to start ticking, like the parked
audit runtime. Every other
storable row's stored value is unwired.

The five existing onboarding destination keys validate before settings writes:
`DISCORD_ANCHOR_WELCOME_CHANNEL_ID`, `DISCORD_SESSION_LOOKING_TO_PLAY_CHANNEL_ID`
and `DISCORD_SESSION_LOBBY_VOICE_CHANNEL_ID` accept optional nonzero u64 IDs;
`DISCORD_LANDING_CHANNEL_IDS` and `DISCORD_GOODBYE_CHANNEL_IDS` accept CSV IDs,
trimming whitespace and omitting empty segments. Validation shares the runtime
parsers and existing JSON-to-env rendering (including booleans, integral numbers
and flat arrays). Stored JSON null is refused; explicit row deletion restores
boot fallback. Repair invalid values or delete the override. Empty syntax does
not satisfy mode-required destinations. Syntax proves no channel existence or
permission and does not change hot wiring or dry-run behavior. See
[settings actions](internal-action-settings.md#onboarding-destinations) for
rendering, typed refusal and no-effect guarantees.

Gateway boot reads process environment only, through a fixed set of loaders:
`Config::from_env` (`DISCORD_TOKEN`, `DATABASE_URL`, `LISTEN_ADDR`, `GUILD_ID`),
`FeatureGates::from_env` (`TWO_AUTOMATIONS`, `TWO_ANNOUNCEMENTS`,
`TWO_TEXT_COMMANDS`, `TWO_FEED_POLL_SECONDS`), `ModerationGates::from_env`
(`TWO_MODERATION`, `TWO_OWEN_USER_ID`, `TWO_MODERATION_PROTECTED_ROLE_IDS`),
a direct `DISCORD_API_BASE` env read,
and `intents_from_env` (`TWO_AUTOMOD`, `DISCORD_TICKET_CATEGORY_ID`,
`DISCORD_TICKET_STAFF_ROLE_ID`, `DISCORD_TICKET_PANEL_CHANNEL_ID`), with
`DISCORD_GATEWAY_URL` as a loopback-only test override. Rows for storable keys
read this way say “env at boot” (plus the live-refresh note where
`STORE_READ_KEYS` applies); every remaining storable row's stored value is
unwired, and `env_only` rows are never dashboard-stored.
When voice is enabled, `build_production_runtime` also reads
`DISCORD_SESSION_LOBBY_VOICE_CHANNEL_ID`, `TWO_TEMP_VOICE_GENERATOR_CHANNEL_ID`,
`TWO_TEMP_VOICE_CATEGORY_ID` and `TWO_TEMP_VOICE_PROTECTED_CHANNEL_IDS` solely
for delete protection, not creator provisioning. Its empty grace is fixed at
60 seconds unless `TWO_TEMP_VOICE_EMPTY_GRACE_SECONDS` (0 to 600) sets it at boot, and a stored per-guild row overrides that boot value live (out-of-range rows fail closed to the boot value).
Automod and scorecard typed loaders exist but are not
called during boot; their defaults below come from empty-map calls.
Onboarding gates are validated at boot (`OnboardingGates::from_env`,
`crates/bot/src/main.rs:563`): an invalid `TWO_ONBOARDING_MODE` fails startup. The
classifier loader runs when the ordered pipeline is built and again when
community-facts capture is armed, then refreshes live for the guild
fact-producing dispatches above. Attendance resolves its live classifier at
execution time in both interaction paths. The separate
`preflight` operator CLI validates further catalog keys from the environment
(channel references, panels, onboarding mode) as a read-only pre-deploy check;
it applies nothing to the running gateway.

## Container bootstrap

`Config` separately reads `DISCORD_TOKEN`, `DATABASE_URL`, `LISTEN_ADDR` and
`GUILD_ID` (see `crates/core/src/config.rs`). These are not aliases automatically
resolved from legacy `TWO_DATABASE_URL` / `DISCORD_GUILD_ID`. Token, database URL
and guild ID have no embedded deployment value; the listen address defaults to
`0.0.0.0:8080`. Missing configuration is not proof of readiness.

### Shutdown

SIGTERM/SIGINT flips `/readyz` to 503, stops gateway intake, drains accepted
dispatches and jobs, commits the gateway checkpoint and closes the pool. The
whole drain is bounded by `SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` (whole seconds, 1–900;
default 35 = the 30 s dispatch drain plus 5 s margin). Past the bound the process
logs `shutdown_deadline_exceeded` and exits 1, so the supervisor restarts from the
last committed checkpoint; a blocking checkpoint writer cannot be abandoned
safely. A second SIGTERM/SIGINT exits 1 immediately. The Container stop
grace period (SIGTERM, 15 minutes, SIGKILL) is a wrangler setting and is not
configured here.

Under the Worker, the Container also receives the reviewed `TWO_*` runtime
flags in `wrangler/src/container-env.ts` (`FORWARDED_FLAGS`), forwarded
verbatim when the Worker env defines them as strings. Secrets never pass
through that allowlist: a Container secret needs its own explicit line in
`containerEnvVars` (`wrangler/src/index.ts`), like `DISCORD_TOKEN` and
`DATABASE_URL`. Every other `TWO_*` name the Rust sources mention sits in
`NOT_FORWARDED` with a reason, and `wrangler/test/container-env.test.ts`
fails when a name is in neither list.

## Settings catalog

Default sources (parsed defaults only, not boot wiring): feature/announcement
gates (`feature_commands.rs`), moderation (`moderation.rs`), onboarding
(`onboarding.rs`), automod (`automod.rs`), scorecard and classifier
(`community.rs`). An empty ID list never contains a live ID.
